command:
cat > /root/lvm-ansible/lvm-data-loop-setup.sh <<'SCRIPT_EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -e
FILE=/var/lib/lvm-backing/data.img
LOOPDEV=/dev/loop10
VG=vg_data

case "$1" in
  start)
    if ! losetup "$LOOPDEV" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      losetup "$LOOPDEV" "$FILE"
    fi
    udevadm settle || true
    vgchange -ay "$VG" || true
    ;;
  stop)
    vgchange -an "$VG" || true
    losetup -d "$LOOPDEV" 2>/dev/null || true
    ;;
esac

command:
cat > /root/lvm-ansible/playbook.yml <<'PLAY_EOF'
---
- name: Provide and grow an LVM logical volume mounted at /srv/data
  hosts: node1
  become: true
  vars:
    backing_dir: /var/lib/lvm-backing
    backing_file: "{{ backing_dir }}/data.img"
    loop_dev: /dev/loop10
    vg_name: vg_data
    lv_name: lv_data
    lv_dev: "/dev/{{ vg_name }}/{{ lv_name }}"
    mount_point: /srv/data
    img_size_mb: 1200
    lv_size_mb: 1000

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure backing directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ backing_dir }}"
        state: directory
        mode: "0700"

    - name: Check backing file
      ansible.builtin.stat:
        path: "{{ backing_file }}"
      register: backing_stat

    - name: Create sparse backing file
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "truncate -s {{ img_size_mb }}M {{ backing_file }}"
      when: not backing_stat.stat.exists

    - name: Grow backing file if needed
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "truncate -s {{ img_size_mb }}M {{ backing_file }}"
      when:
        - backing_stat.stat.exists
        - (backing_stat.stat.size // 1048576) < img_size_mb

    - name: Install loop-device/VG activation helper script
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: lvm-data-loop-setup.sh
        dest: /usr/local/sbin/lvm-data-loop-setup.sh
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Install systemd unit for loop device persistence
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        src: lvm-data-loop.service
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/lvm-data-loop.service
        mode: "0644"
      register: unit_file

    - name: Reload systemd and enable loop unit
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: lvm-data-loop.service
        daemon_reload: "{{ unit_file.changed }}"
        enabled: true

    - name: Ensure loop device is attached to backing file
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "losetup {{ loop_dev }} {{ backing_file }}"
      register: loop_attach
      failed_when: false
      changed_when: loop_attach.rc == 0

    - name: Refresh loop device capacity to match backing file size
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "losetup -c {{ loop_dev }}"
      changed_when: false

    - name: Ensure volume group exists on loop device
      community.general.lvg:
        vg: "{{ vg_name }}"
        pvs: "{{ loop_dev }}"
        state: present

    - name: Resize physical volume to full loop device size
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "pvresize {{ loop_dev }}"
      register: pvresize_out
      changed_when: "'size changed' in pvresize_out.stdout"

    - name: Ensure logical volume exists at requested size
      community.general.lvol:
        vg: "{{ vg_name }}"
        lv: "{{ lv_name }}"
        size: "{{ lv_size_mb }}M"
        state: present
        shrink: false
        resizefs: true

    - name: Ensure filesystem is present on the logical volume
      community.general.filesystem:
        fstype: ext4
        dev: "{{ lv_dev }}"

    - name: Ensure mount point directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ mount_point }}"
        state: directory
        mode: "0755"

    - name: Mount the logical volume at /srv/data
      ansible.posix.mount:
        path: "{{ mount_point }}"
        src: "{{ lv_dev }}"
        fstype: ext4
        opts: "defaults,x-systemd.requires=lvm-data-loop.service"
        state: mounted

    - name: Report resulting filesystem size
      ansible.builtin.command:
        cmd: "df -h {{ mount_point }}"
      register: df_out
      changed_when: false

    - name: Show filesystem size
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        var: df_out.stdout_lines
PLAY_EOF
